run_create_index: run the script to create an index of all pages with metadata from a directory of papers
run_create_index_with_tesseract: run the script with tesseract OCR enabled to extract text from each page image
run_create_index_parallel: run the script with a custom number of worker processes for parallel indexing
review_convert_pt2px: review the convert_pt2px function that converts points to pixels using a configurable DPI
review_read_metadata: review the read_metadata function that parses pdffigures2 metadata and converts region boundaries to pixels
